There is no mention of a different notice period for termination in other clauses of the Kestrel storage agreement.

evidence.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

items.question: When did Jonas Ekberg say the chiller alarm sounded?
items.answer: Jonas Ekberg stated that the chiller alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026 [2]. He also mentioned that he is not sure of the exact minute [2].

items.question: What did the shift supervisor say about the Voss-Lindqvist pallets?
items.answer: The shift supervisor, Jonas Ekberg, stated that the Voss-Lindqvist pallets were moved to Hall 1 by 05:15 on the morning of the chiller failure [1].
